proves.claim: saveAgentAbilities writes the list agentAbilities reads back, a seat never given abilities reads an empty list, and an unknown name is refused USAGE.

store.needs.abilities-save-and-read.why: Without this test a seat's declared abilities could be dropped or misread and no item needing a browser would match it.

proves.claim: register stores a seat's abilities for a fresh join and a rejoin, leaves them when none are given, and refuses ENGINE_VERSION below NEEDS_ENGINE.

store.io-board-register.abilities-real-p.why: Without this test the join path could ignore declared abilities while the store reads them.
